# S55 Colour Scheme Editor

**Homepage:** [http://gsmdev.de/index.php?c=viewprojektinfo&id=10](https://web.archive.org/web/20050313185721/http://gsmdev.de/index.php?c=viewprojektinfo&id=10) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** ACiD[mrp]<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./s55-colour-scheme-editor/img/s55-colour-scheme-editor.png").default}
  alt={"S55 Colour Scheme Editor: screenshot 1"}
/>

S55 Colour Scheme Editor is designed for creating custom colour schemes for the Siemens S55.

- Original S55 palette or 16-bit palette;
- Preview with element selection directly on the image;
- Three standard schemes as templates;
- Transparency settings for each element, including the operator name;
- English, Spanish, French, and Dutch interface languages.

For correct colour display, Windows must be set to a colour depth of at least 24 bits.
